mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as monetary policy eases without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% for two consecutive months signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in payroll employment signal robust labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising new housing starts during housing market booms increase consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as demand expands.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of housing boom periods (HOUST > 1300 thousand units), or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate trend consistently indicates improving labor market conditions that boost corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and rising consumer price inflation signal supply shocks that increase corporate costs and reduce profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining INDPRO and rising CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Falling industrial production during manufacturing slowdowns indicates economic deceleration that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of manufacturing slowdown periods (INDPRO < 105), or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
